{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Count total rows
n_rows = len(data)
print(f'Total rows: {n_rows}')

# Count unique patient_ids
n_unique_patients = len(data['patient_id'].unique())
print(f'Unique patient_ids: {n_unique_patients}')

# Count how many patients have multiple rows
patient_id_counts = data['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicate_patients = patient_id_counts[patient_id_counts > 1]
dup_count = len(duplicate_patients)
print(f'Patients with multiple rows: {dup_count}')

# Deduplicate by keeping the row with the highest sample_seq per patient
deduplicated = data.loc[data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]
n_patients = len(deduplicated)
print(f'Unique patients after deduplication: {n_patients}')"}
